candidates.lead: The Hospitality Award (Hospitality Industry (General) Award 2020, MA000009) sets minimum pay for cafes, restaurants, pubs, clubs and hotels. From 1 July 2026 adult rates run from $25.74 an hour at introductory level to $32.13 at level 6 [[HOSPITALITY_RATES]]; level 1, the entry classification for food and beverage attendants and kitchen hands, is $26.44 an hour, or $33.05 as a casual with the 25% loading.

The hospitality award is the Hospitality Industry (General) Award 2020 (MA000009), the federal award covering cafes, restaurants, pubs, clubs and hotels in every state. For 2026-27 its adult minimums are $25.74 an hour at introductory level, $26.44 at level 1 and $32.13 at level 6 [[HOSPITALITY_RATES]], operative from the first full pay period on or after 1 July 2026. Evening and night work add a flat cash amount.

Hospitality award pay rates are the legal minimum wages for each classification under MA000009, with hourly rates equal to the weekly rate divided by 38 ordinary hours. From 1 July 2026, level 1 pays $1,004.90 a week or $26.44 an hour and level 6 $1,221.10 a week or $32.13 an hour [[HOSPITALITY_RATES]]; casuals receive a 25% loading on the ordinary rate [[HOSPITALITY_AWARD.casualLoading]] but not on overtime.
